description: Search the Germany GovData open data catalogue (CKAN) for datasets by keyword, e.g. query "verkehr": dataset titles, descriptions, publisher and links. Dataset discovery — dataset records themselves are downloaded from the portal; results link back to it. Source: Germany GovData. License: Datenlizenz Deutschland (dl-de/by-2.0 or dl-de/zero-2.0) — datasets filtered at the portal. German-first catalogue — German keywords return the most results.
